name: @cobuntu/sales-ui
description: Shared sales-visibility + host-refund UI for Cobuntu. Provides the SalesSection (KPI cards + sales list + CSV export + sale-detail drawer + per-sale refund modal) used by both event management (/communities/:tag/events/:eventId) and product management (/communities/:tag/marketplace/:productId) surfaces. Consumed by `cobuntu-admin` and (via the host-facing /manage routes) `cobuntu-community-app`. See cobuntu-backend-monorepo/docs/features/host-refunds-and-sales-visibility.md for the umbrella plan.
